# GNK ASG — Pre-launch Functionality Additions

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Purpose

List functionality additions that should be prepared before the first public release, without changing the existing homepage design or current portal functions.

## Additions to prepare

### 1. Preview mode

Prepare the first article as a preview-only package before it is linked publicly.

### 2. Release checklist status

Each publication package should have one simple status:

- draft
- reviewed
- ready
- released
- paused

### 3. Mobile crop note

Every image should include a mobile crop note so the title remains readable on phones.

### 4. Link rollback note

If a link fails after release, remove only that public link and keep the article in preparation.

### 5. Desk routing note

Each article should define what the Desk should do when a user asks about it:

- summarize
- show source
- open related page
- suggest contact

### 6. Source label

Each article should have a label such as:

- GNK ASG Insight
- Public information
- Source-based context
- Weekly brief

### 7. Home impact rule

The first publication should not modify the hero, first screen, primary menu, or main homepage cards.

### 8. Later homepage card

After successful review, a single compact latest-insight card may be added later, but only if approved.

## Decision

These additions should be prepared before publication. They do not require visible public changes now.
